entries.name: Fade in
entries.what_it_does: Opacity 0 to 1.
entries.when_to_use: First panel of a calm film.
entries.when_not_to_use: Styles where elements cut or are written on.

entries.name: Fade out
entries.what_it_does: Opacity 1 to 0.

entries.name: Dip to black
entries.what_it_does: Black rises over the panel and clears.
entries.when_to_use: Scene change with a time jump.

entries.name: Dip to white
entries.what_it_does: White rises over the panel and clears.
entries.when_not_to_use: Dark palettes at night viewing brightness.

entries.name: Dip to colour
entries.what_it_does: A palette colour rises over the panel and clears.
entries.when_not_to_use: When the colour matches the next background.

entries.name: Wipe from right
entries.what_it_does: Panel is revealed from the right edge toward the left.
entries.when_not_to_use: Two wipes in opposite directions back to back.

entries.name: Wipe from left
entries.what_it_does: Panel is revealed from the left edge toward the right.

entries.name: Wipe from top
entries.what_it_does: Panel is revealed from the top down.

entries.name: Wipe from bottom
entries.what_it_does: Panel is revealed from the bottom up.

entries.name: Split reveal
entries.what_it_does: Panel opens from a horizontal centre line.
entries.when_not_to_use: Figure panels: it cuts through the face.

entries.name: Diagonal wipe
entries.what_it_does: A slanted edge sweeps the panel in.

entries.name: Iris in
entries.what_it_does: A circle opens from a point to the full frame.
entries.when_to_use: Starting on a character or object.

entries.name: Iris out
entries.what_it_does: A circle closes onto a point.
entries.when_to_use: The final panel of a playful film.

entries.name: Clock wipe
entries.what_it_does: A radial sweep reveals the panel like a clock hand.

entries.name: Blinds
entries.what_it_does: Horizontal slats open to reveal the panel.
entries.when_not_to_use: Small text: slats cross it while opening.

entries.name: Slide in from left
entries.what_it_does: Whole panel slides in from the left.
entries.when_not_to_use: Styles where marks are written, not moved.

entries.name: Slide in from right
entries.what_it_does: Whole panel slides in from the right.

entries.name: Slide in from below
entries.what_it_does: Whole panel rises in from below.

entries.name: Slide out left
entries.what_it_does: Whole panel leaves to the left.
entries.when_to_use: Paired with slide-in-right on the next panel.

entries.name: Drop in
entries.what_it_does: Panel falls in from above and bounces once.

entries.name: Spin in
entries.what_it_does: Panel rotates a few degrees into place while appearing.

entries.name: Zoom through (in)
entries.what_it_does: Panel arrives by shrinking from 160% with blur.
entries.when_to_use: Second half of a zoom transition.
entries.when_not_to_use: Without zoom-through-out on the previous panel.

entries.name: Zoom through (out)
entries.what_it_does: Panel leaves by growing to 160% with blur.
entries.when_to_use: First half of a zoom transition.

entries.name: Whip pan (in)
entries.what_it_does: Panel streaks in sideways with blur.
entries.when_to_use: Change of place on a beat.

entries.name: Whip pan (out)
entries.what_it_does: Panel streaks out sideways with blur.
entries.when_to_use: First half of a whip pan.

entries.name: Glitch cut
entries.what_it_does: A few frames of horizontal jitter, skew and hue error.

entries.name: Flash cut
entries.what_it_does: A white frame that decays over the new panel.
entries.when_not_to_use: More than three times a film; see the photosensitivity rule.

entries.name: Colour plate wipe
entries.what_it_does: A full-frame palette-colour plate crosses the screen.
entries.when_not_to_use: When the plate colour equals the background.

entries.name: Curtain close
entries.what_it_does: Two panels of colour close from the sides.
